name: evmo-video
description: Видео-обзор ЭВМО для лендинга (Remotion): горизонтальная и вертикальная версии

scripts.music: node music/lounge.mjs music/lounge.wav 47 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i music/lounge.wav -af loudnorm=I=-18:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/music.mp3 && rm music/lounge.wav
scripts.render:desktop: remotion render src/index.ts Desktop out/hero.master.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 --x264-preset=slow --audio-codec=aac && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hero.master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k ../public/landing/hero.mp4
scripts.render:mobile: remotion render src/index.ts Mobile out/hero-mobile.master.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 --x264-preset=slow --audio-codec=aac && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hero-mobile.master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k ../public/landing/hero-mobile.mp4
